066/**
067 * An axis for displaying numerical data.
068 * <P>
069 * If the axis is set up to automatically determine its range to fit the data,
070 * you can ensure that the range includes zero (statisticians usually prefer
071 * this) by setting the {@code autoRangeIncludesZero} flag to
072 * {@code true}.
073 * <P>
074 * The {@code NumberAxis} class has a mechanism for automatically
075 * selecting a tick unit that is appropriate for the current axis range.
076 */
077public class NumberAxis extends ValueAxis implements Cloneable, Serializable {
078
079    /** For serialization. */
080    private static final long serialVersionUID = 2805933088476185789L;
081
082    /** The default value for the autoRangeIncludesZero flag. */
083    public static final boolean DEFAULT_AUTO_RANGE_INCLUDES_ZERO = true;
084
085    /** The default value for the autoRangeStickyZero flag. */
086    public static final boolean DEFAULT_AUTO_RANGE_STICKY_ZERO = true;
087
088    /** The default tick unit. */
089    public static final NumberTickUnit DEFAULT_TICK_UNIT = new NumberTickUnit(
090            1.0, new DecimalFormat("0"));
091
092    /** The default setting for the vertical tick labels flag. */
093    public static final boolean DEFAULT_VERTICAL_TICK_LABELS = false;
094
095    /**
096     * The range type (can be used to force the axis to display only positive
097     * values or only negative values).
098     */
099    private RangeType rangeType;
100
101    /**
102     * A flag that affects the axis range when the range is determined
103     * automatically.  If the auto range does NOT include zero and this flag
104     * is TRUE, then the range is changed to include zero.
105     */
106    private boolean autoRangeIncludesZero;
107
108    /**
109     * A flag that affects the size of the margins added to the axis range when
110     * the range is determined automatically.  If the value 0 falls within the
111     * margin and this flag is TRUE, then the margin is truncated at zero.
112     */
113    private boolean autoRangeStickyZero;
114
115    /** The tick unit for the axis. */
116    private NumberTickUnit tickUnit;
117
118    /** The override number format. */
119    private NumberFormat numberFormatOverride;
120
121    /** An optional band for marking regions on the axis. */
122    private MarkerAxisBand markerBand;

131    /**
132     * Constructs a number axis, using default values where necessary.

134     * @param label  the axis label ({@code null} permitted).
135     */
136    public NumberAxis(String label) {
137        super(label, NumberAxis.createStandardTickUnits());
138        this.rangeType = RangeType.FULL;
139        this.autoRangeIncludesZero = DEFAULT_AUTO_RANGE_INCLUDES_ZERO;
140        this.autoRangeStickyZero = DEFAULT_AUTO_RANGE_STICKY_ZERO;
141        this.tickUnit = DEFAULT_TICK_UNIT;
142        this.numberFormatOverride = null;
143        this.markerBand = null;
144    }

180    /**
181     * Sets the flag that indicates whether the axis range, if
182     * automatically calculated, is forced to include zero.
183     * <p>
184     * If the flag is changed to {@code true}, the axis range is
185     * recalculated.
186     * <p>
187     * Any change to the flag will trigger an {@link AxisChangeEvent}.
188     *
189     * @param flag  the new value of the flag.
190     *
191     * @see #getAutoRangeIncludesZero()
192     */
193    public void setAutoRangeIncludesZero(boolean flag) {
194        if (this.autoRangeIncludesZero != flag) {
195            this.autoRangeIncludesZero = flag;
196            if (isAutoRange()) {
197                autoAdjustRange();
198            }
199            notifyListeners(new AxisChangeEvent(this));
200        }
201    }

267    /**
268     * Sets the tick unit for the axis and, if requested, sends an
269     * {@link AxisChangeEvent} to all registered listeners.  In addition, an
270     * option is provided to turn off the "auto-select" feature for tick units

272     * {@link ValueAxis#setAutoTickUnitSelection(boolean)} method).

274     * @param unit  the new tick unit ({@code null} not permitted).
275     * @param notify  notify listeners?
276     * @param turnOffAutoSelect  turn off the auto-tick selection?

279            boolean turnOffAutoSelect) {
280
281        Args.nullNotPermitted(unit, "unit");
282        this.tickUnit = unit;

284            setAutoTickUnitSelection(false, false);
285        }
286        if (notify) {
287            notifyListeners(new AxisChangeEvent(this));
288        }
289
290    }

343    /**
344     * Configures the axis to work with the specified plot.  If the axis has
345     * auto-scaling, then sets the maximum and minimum values.
346     */
347    @Override
348    public void configure() {
349        if (isAutoRange()) {
350            autoAdjustRange();
351        }
352    }

354    /**
355     * Rescales the axis to ensure that all data is visible.
356     */
357    @Override
358    public Range calculateAutoRange(boolean adhereToMax) {
359
360        Plot plot = getPlot();
361        if (plot == null) {
362            return null;  // no plot, no data
363        }
364
365        if (plot instanceof ValueAxisPlot) {
366            ValueAxisPlot vap = (ValueAxisPlot) plot;
367
368            Range r = vap.getDataRange(this);
369            if (r == null) {
370                r = getDefaultAutoRange();
371            }
372
373            double upper = r.getUpperBound();
374            double lower = r.getLowerBound();
375            if (this.rangeType == RangeType.POSITIVE) {
376                lower = Math.max(0.0, lower);
377                upper = Math.max(0.0, upper);
378            }
379            else if (this.rangeType == RangeType.NEGATIVE) {
380                lower = Math.min(0.0, lower);
381                upper = Math.min(0.0, upper);
382            }
383
384            if (getAutoRangeIncludesZero()) {
385                lower = Math.min(lower, 0.0);
386                upper = Math.max(upper, 0.0);
387            }
388            double range = upper - lower;
389
390            // if fixed auto range, then derive lower bound...
391            double fixedAutoRange = getFixedAutoRange();
392            if (adhereToMax && fixedAutoRange > 0.0) {
393                Range aligned = getAutoRangeAlign().align(
394                        new Range(lower, upper), fixedAutoRange);
395                lower = aligned.getLowerBound();
396                upper = aligned.getUpperBound();
397            }
398            else {
399                // ensure the autorange is at least <minRange> in size...
400                double minRange = getAutoRangeMinimumSize();
401                if (range < minRange) {
402                    double expand = (minRange - range) / 2;
403                    upper = upper + expand;
404                    lower = lower - expand;
405                    if (lower == upper) { // see bug report 1549218
406                        double adjust = Math.abs(lower) / 10.0;
407                        lower = lower - adjust;
408                        upper = upper + adjust;
409                    }
410                    if (this.rangeType == RangeType.POSITIVE) {
411                        if (lower < 0.0) {
412                            upper = upper - lower;
413                            lower = 0.0;
414                        }
415                    }
416                    else if (this.rangeType == RangeType.NEGATIVE) {
417                        if (upper > 0.0) {
418                            lower = lower - upper;
419                            upper = 0.0;
420                        }
421                    }
422                }
423
424                if (getAutoRangeStickyZero()) {
425                    if (upper <= 0.0) {
426                        upper = Math.min(0.0, upper + getUpperMargin() * range);
427                    }
428                    else {
429                        upper = upper + getUpperMargin() * range;
430                    }
431                    if (lower >= 0.0) {
432                        lower = Math.max(0.0, lower - getLowerMargin() * range);
433                    }
434                    else {
435                        lower = lower - getLowerMargin() * range;
436                    }
437                }
438                else {
439                    upper = upper + getUpperMargin() * range;
440                    lower = lower - getLowerMargin() * range;
441                }
442            }
443
444            return new Range(lower, upper);
445        }
446        return null;
447    }

449    /**
450     * Converts a data value to a coordinate in Java2D space, assuming that the
451     * axis runs along one edge of the specified dataArea.
452     * <p>
453     * Note that it is possible for the coordinate to fall outside the plotArea.
454     *
455     * @param value  the data value.
456     * @param area  the area for plotting the data.
457     * @param edge  the axis location.
458     *
459     * @return The Java2D coordinate.
460     *
461     * @see #java2DToValue(double, Rectangle2D, RectangleEdge)
462     */
463    @Override
464    public double valueToJava2D(double value, Rectangle2D area,
465            RectangleEdge edge) {
466
467        Range range = getRange();
468        double axisMin = range.getLowerBound();
469        double axisMax = range.getUpperBound();
470
471        double min = 0.0;
472        double max = 0.0;
473        if (RectangleEdge.isTopOrBottom(edge)) {
474            min = area.getX();
475            max = area.getMaxX();
476        }
477        else if (RectangleEdge.isLeftOrRight(edge)) {
478            max = area.getMinY();
479            min = area.getMaxY();
480        }
481        if (isInverted()) {
482            return max
483                   - ((value - axisMin) / (axisMax - axisMin)) * (max - min);
484        }
485        else {
486            return min
487                   + ((value - axisMin) / (axisMax - axisMin)) * (max - min);
488        }
489
490    }
491
492    /**
493     * Converts a coordinate in Java2D space to the corresponding data value,
494     * assuming that the axis runs along one edge of the specified dataArea.
495     *
496     * @param java2DValue  the coordinate in Java2D space.
497     * @param area  the area in which the data is plotted.
498     * @param edge  the location.
499     *
500     * @return The data value.
501     *
502     * @see #valueToJava2D(double, Rectangle2D, RectangleEdge)
503     */
504    @Override
505    public double java2DToValue(double java2DValue, Rectangle2D area,
506            RectangleEdge edge) {
507
508        Range range = getRange();
509        double axisMin = range.getLowerBound();
510        double axisMax = range.getUpperBound();
511
512        double min = 0.0;
513        double max = 0.0;
514        if (RectangleEdge.isTopOrBottom(edge)) {
515            min = area.getX();
516            max = area.getMaxX();
517        }
518        else if (RectangleEdge.isLeftOrRight(edge)) {
519            min = area.getMaxY();
520            max = area.getY();
521        }
522        if (isInverted()) {
523            return axisMax
524                   - (java2DValue - min) / (max - min) * (axisMax - axisMin);
525        }
526        else {
527            return axisMin
528                   + (java2DValue - min) / (max - min) * (axisMax - axisMin);
529        }
530
531    }
532
533    /**
534     * Calculates the value of the lowest visible tick on the axis.
535     *
536     * @return The value of the lowest visible tick on the axis.
537     *
538     * @see #calculateHighestVisibleTickValue()
539     */
540    protected double calculateLowestVisibleTickValue() {
541        double unit = getTickUnit().getSize();
542        double index = Math.ceil(getRange().getLowerBound() / unit);
543        return index * unit;
544    }
545
546    /**
547     * Calculates the value of the highest visible tick on the axis.
548     *
549     * @return The value of the highest visible tick on the axis.
550     *
551     * @see #calculateLowestVisibleTickValue()
552     */
553    protected double calculateHighestVisibleTickValue() {
554        double unit = getTickUnit().getSize();
555        double index = Math.floor(getRange().getUpperBound() / unit);
556        return index * unit;
557    }
558
559    /**
560     * Calculates the number of visible ticks.
561     *
562     * @return The number of visible ticks on the axis.
563     */
564    protected int calculateVisibleTickCount() {
565        double unit = getTickUnit().getSize();
566        Range range = getRange();
567        return (int) (Math.floor(range.getUpperBound() / unit)
568                      - Math.ceil(range.getLowerBound() / unit) + 1);
569    }

571    /**
572     * Draws the axis on a Java 2D graphics device (such as the screen or a
573     * printer).
574     *
575     * @param g2  the graphics device ({@code null} not permitted).
576     * @param cursor  the cursor location.
577     * @param plotArea  the area within which the axes and data should be drawn
578     *                  ({@code null} not permitted).
579     * @param dataArea  the area within which the data should be drawn
580     *                  ({@code null} not permitted).
581     * @param edge  the location of the axis ({@code null} not permitted).
582     * @param plotState  collects information about the plot
583     *                   ({@code null} permitted).
584     *
585     * @return The axis state (never {@code null}).
586     */
587    @Override
588    public AxisState draw(Graphics2D g2, double cursor, Rectangle2D plotArea,
589            Rectangle2D dataArea, RectangleEdge edge,
590            PlotRenderingInfo plotState) {
591
592        AxisState state;
593        // if the axis is not visible, don't draw it...
594        if (!isVisible()) {
595            state = new AxisState(cursor);
596            // even though the axis is not visible, we need ticks for the
597            // gridlines...
598            List ticks = refreshTicks(g2, state, dataArea, edge);
599            state.setTicks(ticks);
600            return state;
601        }
602
603        // draw the tick marks and labels...
604        state = drawTickMarksAndLabels(g2, cursor, plotArea, dataArea, edge);
605
606        if (getAttributedLabel() != null) {
607            state = drawAttributedLabel(getAttributedLabel(), g2, plotArea, 
608                    dataArea, edge, state);
609            
610        } else {
611            state = drawLabel(getLabel(), g2, plotArea, dataArea, edge, state);
612        }
613        createAndAddEntity(cursor, state, dataArea, edge, plotState);
614        return state;
615
616    }

681    /**
682     * Estimates the maximum tick label height.
683     *
684     * @param g2  the graphics device.
685     *
686     * @return The maximum height.
687     */
688    protected double estimateMaximumTickLabelHeight(Graphics2D g2) {
689        RectangleInsets tickLabelInsets = getTickLabelInsets();
690        double result = tickLabelInsets.getTop() + tickLabelInsets.getBottom();
691
692        Font tickLabelFont = getTickLabelFont();
693        FontRenderContext frc = g2.getFontRenderContext();
694        result += tickLabelFont.getLineMetrics("123", frc).getHeight();
695        return result;
696    }
697
698    /**
699     * Estimates the maximum width of the tick labels, assuming the specified
700     * tick unit is used.
701     * <P>
702     * Rather than computing the string bounds of every tick on the axis, we
703     * just look at two values: the lower bound and the upper bound for the
704     * axis.  These two values will usually be representative.
705     *
706     * @param g2  the graphics device.
707     * @param unit  the tick unit to use for calculation.
708     *
709     * @return The estimated maximum width of the tick labels.
710     */
711    protected double estimateMaximumTickLabelWidth(Graphics2D g2,
712                                                   TickUnit unit) {
713
714        RectangleInsets tickLabelInsets = getTickLabelInsets();
715        double result = tickLabelInsets.getLeft() + tickLabelInsets.getRight();
716
717        if (isVerticalTickLabels()) {
718            // all tick labels have the same width (equal to the height of the
719            // font)...
720            FontRenderContext frc = g2.getFontRenderContext();
721            LineMetrics lm = getTickLabelFont().getLineMetrics("0", frc);
722            result += lm.getHeight();
723        }
724        else {
725            // look at lower and upper bounds...
726            FontMetrics fm = g2.getFontMetrics(getTickLabelFont());
727            Range range = getRange();
728            double lower = range.getLowerBound();
729            double upper = range.getUpperBound();
730            String lowerStr, upperStr;
731            NumberFormat formatter = getNumberFormatOverride();
732            if (formatter != null) {
733                lowerStr = formatter.format(lower);
734                upperStr = formatter.format(upper);
735            }
736            else {
737                lowerStr = unit.valueToString(lower);
738                upperStr = unit.valueToString(upper);
739            }
740            double w1 = fm.stringWidth(lowerStr);
741            double w2 = fm.stringWidth(upperStr);
742            result += Math.max(w1, w2);
743        }
744
745        return result;
746
747    }

749    /**
750     * Selects an appropriate tick value for the axis.  The strategy is to
751     * display as many ticks as possible (selected from an array of 'standard'
752     * tick units) without the labels overlapping.
753     *
754     * @param g2  the graphics device.
755     * @param dataArea  the area defined by the axes.
756     * @param edge  the axis location.
757     */
758    protected void selectAutoTickUnit(Graphics2D g2, Rectangle2D dataArea,
759            RectangleEdge edge) {
760
761        if (RectangleEdge.isTopOrBottom(edge)) {
762            selectHorizontalAutoTickUnit(g2, dataArea, edge);
763        }
764        else if (RectangleEdge.isLeftOrRight(edge)) {
765            selectVerticalAutoTickUnit(g2, dataArea, edge);
766        }
767
768    }
769
770    /**
771     * Selects an appropriate tick value for the axis.  The strategy is to
772     * display as many ticks as possible (selected from an array of 'standard'
773     * tick units) without the labels overlapping.
774     *
775     * @param g2  the graphics device.
776     * @param dataArea  the area defined by the axes.
777     * @param edge  the axis location.
778     */
779    protected void selectHorizontalAutoTickUnit(Graphics2D g2,
780            Rectangle2D dataArea, RectangleEdge edge) {
781
782        TickUnit unit = getTickUnit();
783        TickUnitSource tickUnitSource = getStandardTickUnits();
784 
785        // we should start with the current tick unit if it gives a count in 
786        // the range 3 to 40 otherwise estimate one that will give a count <= 10
787        double length = getRange().getLength();
788        int count = (int) (length / unit.getSize());
789        if (count < 3 || count > 40) {
790            unit = tickUnitSource.getCeilingTickUnit(length / 10);
791        }
792
793        // now consider the label size relative to the width of the tick unit
794        // and make a guess at the ideal size
795        TickUnit unit1 = tickUnitSource.getCeilingTickUnit(unit);
796        double tickLabelWidth = estimateMaximumTickLabelWidth(g2, unit1);
797        double unit1Width = lengthToJava2D(unit1.getSize(), dataArea, edge);       
798        NumberTickUnit unit2 = (NumberTickUnit) unit1;
799        double guess = (tickLabelWidth / unit1Width) * unit1.getSize();
800        
801        // due to limitations of double precision, when you zoom very far into
802        // a chart, eventually the visible axis range will get reported as 
803        // having length 0, and then 'guess' above will be infinite ... in that 
804        // case we'll just stick with the tick unit we have, it's better than 
805        // throwing an exception 
806        // https://github.com/jfree/jfreechart/issues/64
807        if (Double.isFinite(guess)) {
808            unit2 = (NumberTickUnit) tickUnitSource.getCeilingTickUnit(guess);
809            double unit2Width = lengthToJava2D(unit2.getSize(), dataArea, edge);
810            tickLabelWidth = estimateMaximumTickLabelWidth(g2, unit2);
811            if (tickLabelWidth > unit2Width) {
812                unit2 = (NumberTickUnit) tickUnitSource.getLargerTickUnit(unit2);
813            }
814        }
815        setTickUnit(unit2, false, false);
816    }
817
818    /**
819     * Selects an appropriate tick value for the axis.  The strategy is to
820     * display as many ticks as possible (selected from an array of 'standard'
821     * tick units) without the labels overlapping.
822     *
823     * @param g2  the graphics device.
824     * @param dataArea  the area in which the plot should be drawn.
825     * @param edge  the axis location.
826     */
827    protected void selectVerticalAutoTickUnit(Graphics2D g2, 
828            Rectangle2D dataArea, RectangleEdge edge) {
829
830        double tickLabelHeight = estimateMaximumTickLabelHeight(g2);
831
832        // start with the current tick unit...
833        TickUnitSource tickUnits = getStandardTickUnits();
834        TickUnit unit1 = tickUnits.getCeilingTickUnit(getTickUnit());
835        double unitHeight = lengthToJava2D(unit1.getSize(), dataArea, edge);
836        double guess;
837        if (unitHeight > 0) { // then extrapolate...
838            guess = (tickLabelHeight / unitHeight) * unit1.getSize();
839        } else { 
840            guess = getRange().getLength() / 20.0;
841        }
842        NumberTickUnit unit2 = (NumberTickUnit) tickUnits.getCeilingTickUnit(
843                guess);
844        double unit2Height = lengthToJava2D(unit2.getSize(), dataArea, edge);
845
846        tickLabelHeight = estimateMaximumTickLabelHeight(g2);
847        if (tickLabelHeight > unit2Height) {
848            unit2 = (NumberTickUnit) tickUnits.getLargerTickUnit(unit2);
849        }
850        setTickUnit(unit2, false, false);
851
852    }

854    /**
855     * Calculates the positions of the tick labels for the axis, storing the
856     * results in the tick label list (ready for drawing).
857     *
858     * @param g2  the graphics device.
859     * @param state  the axis state.
860     * @param dataArea  the area in which the plot should be drawn.
861     * @param edge  the location of the axis.
862     *
863     * @return A list of ticks.
864     */
865    @Override
866    public List refreshTicks(Graphics2D g2, AxisState state, 
867            Rectangle2D dataArea, RectangleEdge edge) {
868
869        List result = new java.util.ArrayList();
870        if (RectangleEdge.isTopOrBottom(edge)) {
871            result = refreshTicksHorizontal(g2, dataArea, edge);
872        }
873        else if (RectangleEdge.isLeftOrRight(edge)) {
874            result = refreshTicksVertical(g2, dataArea, edge);
875        }
876        return result;
877
878    }

880    /**
881     * Calculates the positions of the tick labels for the axis, storing the
882     * results in the tick label list (ready for drawing).
883     *
884     * @param g2  the graphics device.
885     * @param dataArea  the area in which the data should be drawn.
886     * @param edge  the location of the axis.
887     *
888     * @return A list of ticks.
889     */
890    protected List refreshTicksHorizontal(Graphics2D g2,
891            Rectangle2D dataArea, RectangleEdge edge) {
892
893        List result = new java.util.ArrayList();
894
895        Font tickLabelFont = getTickLabelFont();
896        g2.setFont(tickLabelFont);
897
898        if (isAutoTickUnitSelection()) {
899            selectAutoTickUnit(g2, dataArea, edge);
900        }
901
902        TickUnit tu = getTickUnit();
903        double size = tu.getSize();
904        int count = calculateVisibleTickCount();
905        double lowestTickValue = calculateLowestVisibleTickValue();
906
907        if (count <= ValueAxis.MAXIMUM_TICK_COUNT) {
908            int minorTickSpaces = getMinorTickCount();
909            if (minorTickSpaces <= 0) {
910                minorTickSpaces = tu.getMinorTickCount();
911            }
912            for (int minorTick = 1; minorTick < minorTickSpaces; minorTick++) {
913                double minorTickValue = lowestTickValue 
914                        - size * minorTick / minorTickSpaces;
915                if (getRange().contains(minorTickValue)) {
916                    result.add(new NumberTick(TickType.MINOR, minorTickValue,
917                            "", TextAnchor.TOP_CENTER, TextAnchor.CENTER,
918                            0.0));
919                }
920            }
921            for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
922                double currentTickValue = lowestTickValue + (i * size);
923                String tickLabel;
924                NumberFormat formatter = getNumberFormatOverride();
925                if (formatter != null) {
926                    tickLabel = formatter.format(currentTickValue);
927                }
928                else {
929                    tickLabel = getTickUnit().valueToString(currentTickValue);
930                }
931                TextAnchor anchor, rotationAnchor;
932                double angle = 0.0;
933                if (isVerticalTickLabels()) {
934                    anchor = TextAnchor.CENTER_RIGHT;
935                    rotationAnchor = TextAnchor.CENTER_RIGHT;
936                    if (edge == RectangleEdge.TOP) {
937                        angle = Math.PI / 2.0;
938                    }
939                    else {
940                        angle = -Math.PI / 2.0;
941                    }
942                }
943                else {
944                    if (edge == RectangleEdge.TOP) {
945                        anchor = TextAnchor.BOTTOM_CENTER;
946                        rotationAnchor = TextAnchor.BOTTOM_CENTER;
947                    }
948                    else {
949                        anchor = TextAnchor.TOP_CENTER;
950                        rotationAnchor = TextAnchor.TOP_CENTER;
951                    }
952                }
953
954                Tick tick = new NumberTick(currentTickValue, tickLabel, anchor, 
955                        rotationAnchor, angle);
956                result.add(tick);
957                double nextTickValue = lowestTickValue + ((i + 1) * size);
958                for (int minorTick = 1; minorTick < minorTickSpaces;
959                        minorTick++) {
960                    double minorTickValue = currentTickValue
961                            + (nextTickValue - currentTickValue)
962                            * minorTick / minorTickSpaces;
963                    if (getRange().contains(minorTickValue)) {
964                        result.add(new NumberTick(TickType.MINOR,
965                                minorTickValue, "", TextAnchor.TOP_CENTER,
966                                TextAnchor.CENTER, 0.0));
967                    }
968                }
969            }
970        }
971        return result;
972
973    }

975    /**
976     * Calculates the positions of the tick labels for the axis, storing the
977     * results in the tick label list (ready for drawing).
978     *
979     * @param g2  the graphics device.
980     * @param dataArea  the area in which the plot should be drawn.
981     * @param edge  the location of the axis.
982     *
983     * @return A list of ticks.
984     */
985    protected List refreshTicksVertical(Graphics2D g2,
986            Rectangle2D dataArea, RectangleEdge edge) {
987
988        List<Tick> result = new ArrayList<>();
989        Font tickLabelFont = getTickLabelFont();
990        g2.setFont(tickLabelFont);
991        if (isAutoTickUnitSelection()) {
992            selectAutoTickUnit(g2, dataArea, edge);
993        }
994
995        TickUnit tu = getTickUnit();
996        double size = tu.getSize();
997        int count = calculateVisibleTickCount();
998        double lowestTickValue = calculateLowestVisibleTickValue();
999
1000        if (count <= ValueAxis.MAXIMUM_TICK_COUNT) {
1001            int minorTickSpaces = getMinorTickCount();
1002            if (minorTickSpaces <= 0) {
1003                minorTickSpaces = tu.getMinorTickCount();
1004            }
1005            for (int minorTick = 1; minorTick < minorTickSpaces; minorTick++) {
1006                double minorTickValue = lowestTickValue
1007                        - size * minorTick / minorTickSpaces;
1008                if (getRange().contains(minorTickValue)) {
1009                    result.add(new NumberTick(TickType.MINOR, minorTickValue,
1010                            "", TextAnchor.TOP_CENTER, TextAnchor.CENTER,
1011                            0.0));
1012                }
1013            }
1014
1015            for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
1016                double currentTickValue = lowestTickValue + (i * size);
1017                String tickLabel;
1018                NumberFormat formatter = getNumberFormatOverride();
1019                if (formatter != null) {
1020                    tickLabel = formatter.format(currentTickValue);
1021                }
1022                else {
1023                    tickLabel = getTickUnit().valueToString(currentTickValue);
1024                }
1025
1026                TextAnchor anchor;
1027                TextAnchor rotationAnchor;
1028                double angle = 0.0;
1029                if (isVerticalTickLabels()) {
1030                    if (edge == RectangleEdge.LEFT) {
1031                        anchor = TextAnchor.BOTTOM_CENTER;
1032                        rotationAnchor = TextAnchor.BOTTOM_CENTER;
1033                        angle = -Math.PI / 2.0;
1034                    }
1035                    else {
1036                        anchor = TextAnchor.BOTTOM_CENTER;
1037                        rotationAnchor = TextAnchor.BOTTOM_CENTER;
1038                        angle = Math.PI / 2.0;
1039                    }
1040                }
1041                else {
1042                    if (edge == RectangleEdge.LEFT) {
1043                        anchor = TextAnchor.CENTER_RIGHT;
1044                        rotationAnchor = TextAnchor.CENTER_RIGHT;
1045                    }
1046                    else {
1047                        anchor = TextAnchor.CENTER_LEFT;
1048                        rotationAnchor = TextAnchor.CENTER_LEFT;
1049                    }
1050                }
1051
1052                Tick tick = new NumberTick(currentTickValue, tickLabel, anchor,
1053                        rotationAnchor, angle);
1054                result.add(tick);
1055
1056                double nextTickValue = lowestTickValue + ((i + 1) * size);
1057                for (int minorTick = 1; minorTick < minorTickSpaces;
1058                        minorTick++) {
1059                    double minorTickValue = currentTickValue
1060                            + (nextTickValue - currentTickValue)
1061                            * minorTick / minorTickSpaces;
1062                    if (getRange().contains(minorTickValue)) {
1063                        result.add(new NumberTick(TickType.MINOR,
1064                                minorTickValue, "", TextAnchor.TOP_CENTER,
1065                                TextAnchor.CENTER, 0.0));
1066                    }
1067                }
1068            }
1069        }
1070        return result;
1071
1072    }

1074    /**
1075     * Returns a clone of the axis.
1076     *
1077     * @return A clone
1078     *
1079     * @throws CloneNotSupportedException if some component of the axis does
1080     *         not support cloning.
1081     */
1082    @Override
1083    public Object clone() throws CloneNotSupportedException {
1084        NumberAxis clone = (NumberAxis) super.clone();
1085        if (this.numberFormatOverride != null) {
1086            clone.numberFormatOverride
1087                = (NumberFormat) this.numberFormatOverride.clone();
1088        }

1092    /**
1093     * Tests the axis for equality with an arbitrary object.
1094     *
1095     * @param obj  the object ({@code null} permitted).
1096     *
1097     * @return A boolean.
1098     */
1099    @Override
1100    public boolean equals(Object obj) {
1101        if (obj == this) {
1102            return true;
1103        }
1104        if (!(obj instanceof NumberAxis)) {
1105            return false;
1106        }
1107        NumberAxis that = (NumberAxis) obj;
1108        if (this.autoRangeIncludesZero != that.autoRangeIncludesZero) {
1109            return false;
1110        }
1111        if (this.autoRangeStickyZero != that.autoRangeStickyZero) {
1112            return false;
1113        }
1114        if (!Objects.equals(this.tickUnit, that.tickUnit)) {
1115            return false;
1116        }
1117        if (!Objects.equals(this.numberFormatOverride,
1118                that.numberFormatOverride)) {
1119            return false;
1120        }
1121        if (!this.rangeType.equals(that.rangeType)) {
1122            return false;
1123        }
1124        return super.equals(obj);
1125    }
